canonical_title: Sekoia rolls out Elevate agentic cybersecurity platform
treatment: Repeat only for independent performance evidence, supported-model/tooling details, pricing/availability changes, major customer adoption, or material safety findings.
known_facts: Sekoia rolled Elevate out to clients after early access with around 2,000 customers.
Elevate lets customers connect a preferred AI model to cybersecurity tools for autonomous threat analysis.
Sekoia says early-access service providers reported investigation times reduced by up to fivefold.
reinclude_only_if: Independent benchmark or production metrics are published.

notes: Reuters timestamp 2026-09-30 12:02 UTC (21:02 JST), inside Night window. Vendor-reported fivefold investigation-time reduction is not independent validation.
